proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.none
proposed_widenings.justification: The item uses repeatable Magic-action command words without charges, uses, or any reset cadence. The activation family exists, but it currently requires an expendable resource.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use"

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.destroy_on_attached_form_zero_hp
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be destroyed when one of its transformed vessel forms is reduced to 0 Hit Points, which is not representable by the current exhaustion-based destruction policies.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed."

proposed_widenings.name: Activation predicate: item_has_no_creatures_aboard
proposed_widenings.justification: The fold-back command is only legal when no creatures are aboard, and the current activation surface has no generic non-equipment predicate for that condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard."

notes: Core transform mechanics map to existing item attachment + alter_item_kind, so this is not structural or atom pressure. I did not author placeholder Dhall/JSON because the activation and destruction constraints cannot be represented honestly.
